svg.title: 过度截取正文的示例
svg.desc: 大段无关模拟正文挤占画面，真正的小图表位于右下角。
svg.text: 2.2 Synthetic paper body accidentally captured in a figure crop
This original fixture text is intentionally irrelevant. A useful figure crop should focus
on the diagram, chart, or table rather than swallowing a page of explanatory prose.
The text is not sourced from a paper and exists only to test crop-excess detection.
A caption may be useful when requested; surrounding paragraphs usually are not.
Repeated lines emphasize that this crop has the wrong visual focus.
The small benchmark chart at bottom right is the intended object of interest.
图注：小图位于右下，正文不应成为截图主体。
